mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (measured as 3-month year-over-year growth > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in year-over-year CPI inflation signals a monetary tightening cycle that is not yet fully priced in, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market adjusts to the new policy stance.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (measured as the product of their 3-month changes) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day returns are not significantly positive when the interaction condition is met (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% year-over-year), a decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% yoy, INDPRO declines (3-month yoy < 0) but SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% decline in housing starts from the previous month signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), a decline in the unemployment rate signals strengthening labor conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising (3-month year-over-year growth > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A 10% year-over-year increase in real sales of durable goods (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS yoy growth > 10%.
